finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs from the bump, not noise.

[options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`. The new shape is `retryCount`. It now takes either.

[retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) threw on `undefined`. The new loader leaves unset flags unset. That now means off.

The 8 remaining warnings are real deprecations in `src/legacy` and `src/utils`. They do not break the build. Worth cleaning up next if you want zero output.
